verdict.rationale: Segment's Functions feature lets engineers write custom JavaScript to create sources/destinations and transform data with 'just a few lines of code,' which supports in-pipeline custom-code transformation and enrichment (segment-docs-5, segment-docs-30). However, the evidence doesn't explicitly cover the dedicated Transformations product for filtering/mapping events before destinations, nor independent/hands-on validation of these capabilities. Missing for 10: explicit docs on the Transformations feature (event filtering/field mapping UI), examples of filtering logic, and third-party/hands-on confirmation that custom code works reliably in production pipelines.
